title: CPCSC Level 1 public posting review and removal need operating records
remediation: The sponsor public information owner identifies assessed public systems and authorized publishers. Verify training that keeps specified contract information out of publicly accessible content. Retain a periodic review sample and a redacted correction or safe exercise showing removal and escalation of improperly posted material. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the approved public-system and publisher inventory, training record, latest content review and removal or exercise record
